new_libraries.name: PsramStl
new_libraries.author: Manuel Núñez
new_libraries.sentence: Put std::vector, std::map, std::string, and your own objects in the ESP32's PSRAM.
new_libraries.paragraph: Header-only C++17 allocators for every standard container, smart pointers, and a base class for your own types. Choose PSRAM-only or PSRAM-first with internal RAM fallback. Includes diagnostics and works with Arduino-ESP32 and ESP-IDF.
